site_snapshot.basis: no governed Lithuania place-of-worship snapshot is included in this census-affiliation release
site_snapshot.notes: The product ships census-affiliation metrics and municipality geometry only; place-density fields are null. The 2021 religious-community values are a sample/model-based ethnocultural statistical-survey estimate: 56,000 household residents completed the questionnaire themselves, interviewers surveyed a further 115,000 household residents, and mathematical methods produced the population estimates. See the State Data Agency's official release: https://osp.stat.gov.lt/en/2021-gyventoju-ir-bustu-surasymo-rezultatai/tautybe-gimtoji-kalba-ir-tikyba. A single confidential cell in the 2001 expanded national presentation and a single no-phenomenon cell in the 2021 expanded national presentation remain unavailable; the builder neither zero-fills nor redistributes them.

indicators.label: Resident population
indicators.description: Published municipality population total in OSP flow S3R778_GBS010306_1.
indicators.method: Published Iš viso pagal religiją municipality value.
indicators.temporal_coverage: 2001 and 2011 full-enumeration censuses; 2021 sample/model-based ethnocultural statistical survey published with the register-based census.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Sixty Lithuanian municipalities on the current 2025 boundary frame.
indicators.quality_notes: Nenurodyta, the source's not-indicated religion category, remains in the total.

indicators.label: Religious community indicated (%)
indicators.description: Share assigned to a named religious community in the source municipality presentation.
indicators.method: 100 times (Iš viso pagal religiją minus Nė vienai minus Nenurodyta) divided by Iš viso pagal religiją.
indicators.temporal_coverage: 2001 and 2011 full-enumeration censuses; 2021 sample/model-based ethnocultural statistical survey published with the register-based census.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Sixty Lithuanian municipalities on the current 2025 boundary frame.
indicators.quality_notes: The 2021 value is a sample/model-based estimate. No change metric is calculated between 2001/2011 census enumeration and the 2021 instrument.

indicators.method: 100 times the published Nė vienai municipality value divided by Iš viso pagal religiją.
indicators.temporal_coverage: 2001 and 2011 full-enumeration censuses; 2021 sample/model-based ethnocultural statistical survey published with the register-based census.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Sixty Lithuanian municipalities on the current 2025 boundary frame.
indicators.quality_notes: Nė vienai and Nenurodyta remain separate. The 2021 value is a sample/model-based estimate, and no cross-instrument change is reported.
